title.narrative: Eswatini Youth Empowerment Programme (EYEP) - UNDP SWZ

description.narrative: The objective of the Youth Fellowship Programme is to reduce youth unemployment by 50% by 2025 through connecting young talented graduates with local job opportunities, and empowering non-graduates with digital, entrepreneurship and artisan skills to create jobs for themselves and contribute to the socio-economic development of Eswatini. The ultimate aim of the programme is to absorb the 4,000 graduates coming out of the various tertiary institutions annually, through a 12-months learn to earn volunteerism model, whilst giving non-graduate youth the opportunity to choose from a number of marketable skills including digital skills, renewable energy skills, artisan skills and an entrepreneurship support programme.It consists of 1) absorbing 100% of unemployed graduates into public and private sector through a 12-month stipend paid internship programme. 2) The energy academy in partnership with the University of Eswatini trains young people to better service renewable energy value chains relative to design, installation, and maintenance. 3) A technology hub to harness the social media whizz into productive digital ventures. 4) vocational skills training to reach out to those with little to no education building, upon their entrepreneurial skills and 5) Entrepreneurship Support Programme to improve business leadership, governance and management and increase access to finance for youth led businesses.The programme will serve the four regions of eSwatini, ensuring that no youth is left behind and that organisations and youth from all parts of the country can participate, through a merit-based selection. The programme aims for 50% of the beneficiaries to be female youth.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
